verdict.rationale: Convex is a database product, so this axis applies. However, the evidence describes access only through TypeScript functions, Convex client libraries and HTTP endpoints, with "no need to write any SQL." Nothing documents exposing a connection string for standard database clients or ORMs. Self-hosted Convex can run on Postgres or RDS as its storage backend, but that is a deployment option, not a documented way to connect standard clients to your Convex data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect to the underlying database with standard clients and ORMs via a connection string
